issues.description: The problem specification (UML and textual description) requires calculateRemainingOrderNumber() to return an int (the number of remaining orders) and provides example output lines, but the provided solution implements calculateRemainingOrderNumber() as a void method that only prints order numbers and uses an off-by-one calculation (orders.length + 1). This return-type and behavioral mismatch between the problem statement and the solution will confuse students about the expected method signature and behavior and may cause tests or grading code that expect an int return value to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the specification: change SealSaloon.calculateRemainingOrderNumber() to return an int (e.g., public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber()). Make it return the number of remaining orders (this.orders.length) rather than orders.length + 1. If printing the order numbers is desired for demonstration, keep the print statements but still return the integer count. Alternatively, if the intended behavior is only to print and not return a value, update the problem statement/UML to declare the method as void and adjust the textual description to remove the requirement to return an int.
